formSettings.name: Abdelmomen
formSettings.aboutme: Mid-Level Frontend Developer with 4+ years of professional experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using JavaScript, Vue.js, and Nuxt.js. Skilled in state management with Vuex and Pinia, RESTful API integration, and delivering pixel-perfect implementations from UI/UX wireframes. Experienced in collaborative Git workflows, end-to-end testing with Playwright, and applying Design Systems principles. Focused on Core Web Vitals, performance optimization, and cross-browser compatibility to deliver exceptional user experiences.

education.title: BACHELOR OF INFORMATION SYSTEMS AND ADMINISTRATIVE

work.title: Software Developer (Intern) | Frontend
work.summary:
• Built responsive web pages from UI/UX wireframes using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

work.title: Software Developer (Junior) | Frontend
work.summary:
• Developed and maintained responsive web applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js with a focus on performance optimization.

  • Managed application state using Vuex, implementing structured store modules for scalable data flow.

  • Integrated RESTful APIs for data fetching, form submissions, and real-time content updates.

  • Participated in collaborative Git workflows including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews on GitHub/GitLab.

  • Translated Adobe XD design files into fully functional, pixel-perfect websites with TailwindCSS and SASS/SCSS, ensuring cross-device compatibility.

work.title: Software Engineer | Mid-Senior Frontend
work.summary:
• Lead frontend development of web applications using Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and JavaScript (ES6+), delivering performant and accessible user interfaces.

  • Architect and implement state management solutions using Vuex and Pinia, ensuring predictable data flow across complex application modules.

  • Design and consume RESTful APIs, collaborating with backend teams to define contracts and optimize payload structures.

  • Champion performance optimization practices including Core Web Vitals monitoring, lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimization.

  • Implement end-to-end testing workflows using Playwright to ensure application reliability and catch regressions.

  • Contribute to Design Systems by building reusable, documented Vue.js components for consistent UI patterns across projects.

  • Manage collaborative Git workflows, conduct code reviews, and mentor junior developers on best practices.

  • Build responsive, mobile-first layouts using TailwindCSS with full cross-browser compatibility.
